consulting.headline:
Your recurring work,
done by a system.
consulting.subhead: Every week your team rebuilds the same reports, newsletters, and many more tasks. I build systems that produce that work for you, on schedule, on-brand, and accountable. For the parts that don't repeat, I teach your team to work with AI so they move faster there too.

brief.label: Who this is for
brief.heading: The brief.
paragraphs: Most "AI strategy" is a slide deck. This is the opposite: working systems that produce your recurring work, built to your brand, grounded in your data, with a person accountable for what goes out the door.

I work with research nonprofits, foundations, think tanks, and small expert teams — the ones who publish to make their case and rebuild the same reports, briefs, and newsletters from scratch every cycle. The work is valuable. Doing it by hand, over and over, is not.

differentiator.label: The honest version
differentiator.heading: Not just a chatbot.
paragraphs: Artificial intelligence is much more than a chatbot.

Anyone can get a draft out of a chatbot. The hard part is knowing what AI can be trusted with in your business, then building a system that runs every cycle, stays grounded in your data, and leaves a paper trail you can audit. That is what you are paying for, and it is the part a generic chatbot won't do.

stat.label: of company AI pilots never deliver a measurable return.
stat.note: The ones run with an outside specialist succeed about twice as often as in-house builds.
stat.source: MIT, State of AI in Business 2025

items.title: Opportunity Audit.
items.tagline: Two to three weeks. A plain plan and a fixed price before you commit to a build.
items.blurb: I sort your team's recurring work into three buckets: what to automate, what to train your people on, and what to leave to humans. You walk away with one measurable target and a fixed quote for the build. No obligation to go further.
outcomes: Your work mapped: automate, empower, or leave alone.
One measurable outcome the build will be held to.
A fixed build price, credited back if you proceed.

steps.title: Audit.
steps.body: We start with a short audit. Identify a low-hanging fruit and together we pin down the one outcome that matters. I give you a fixed price for the pilot build — so nothing's a surprise before the real work starts.

steps.title: Build.
steps.body: I build it hands-on, integrating it as much as possible with your own tools, in short cycles you can follow. It runs on your data, and a person signs off before anything goes out — so you can trust what it produces.

steps.title: Run it.
steps.body: The system and its docs are yours to keep. Most people keep me on to maintain it, smooth out the edge cases, and automate the next thing — but you're never locked in. The build is the start, not the finish.
